svg.title: Directed corners and white channels in three frets
svg.desc: The shared tip of a red and blue corner is a rotation center. Connected white regions are filled according to their exposed openings.

g.text: The same ink exposes different patterns when read as a path, a pivot or a boundary.
Two corners share a rotation center
North, then west. Its corner turns left.
North, then east. Its corner turns right.
Turn the red ink 90° counterclockwise about the open dot.
It covers the blue arms in reverse traversal order.
Arrows follow the pen. The highlighted extent is one tick on each arm.
Spacing between pivots on the midline
Colored brackets mark the open spans.
Black strokes bound the connected white regions.
The strip shows three periods. Left and right edges continue into the next repeat.
Three signatures at the same tick scale
Gap widths are distinct centerline separations in ticks, measured between neighboring parallel strokes.
